simple.meaning: אֳנִיָּה (ʼŏnîyâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a ship.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֳנִיָּה (H591) appears 32 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:13, with occurrences in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 7 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֳנִיָּה (H591) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֳנִיָּה (H591) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֳנִיָּה (ʼŏnîyâh) / H591 is traced through Genesis 49:13, Deuteronomy 28:68, Judges 5:17, 1 Kings 9:27 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
